reason: I'd self-host the free version on my Mac mini and try it, but I won't pay $99 a month for a hosted server from a pre-alpha one-person project. I don't hand our schedules or agent logins to someone else's server anyway.
objection: A looping or failing run could burn our whole agent quota overnight. Nothing here says there are spend caps, retry limits or a kill switch. And one developer in pre-alpha might vanish next year.
would_change_my_mind: Hard per-run budget and retry limits that stop a run before it eats our quota, plus a few months of the self-hosted version working on real nights without surprises.
